rv.q: What’s most impressive about “Triumph” is how clear-eyed it is.

Triumph, like so many new political plays at our major nonprofits these days, is preaching to a very particular choir: people who can't get through a conversation without mentioning the T-word through gritted teeth.

cn.t: Churchill's sharp 20-minute play earns praise for its brilliant historical resonance, drawing timely parallels through Ashford's commanding portrayal of a press secretary boasting of an emperor's achievements.
